1. **OBS Studio** (`obs-studio`, `com.obsproject.Studio`) - Lines 60-61
2. **GIMP** (`gimp`, `org.gimp.GIMP`) - Lines 62-63  
3. **Blender** (`blender`, `org.blender.Blender`) - Lines 64-65
4. **Telegram** (`telegram`, `org.telegram.desktop`) - Lines 58-59
5. **VLC Media Player** (`vlc-media-player`, `org.videolan.VLC`) - Lines 208-209
6. **7-Zip** (`7zip`, `org.7-zip.7zip`) - Lines 192-193
7. **Mumble** (`mumble`, `info.mumble.Mumble`) - Lines 172-173
